To echo the ideas forwarded below, the Ways were grown and are a part of the pattern.  Portal worlds are "worlds of 'IF' " as described in The Great Hunt.  So in truth, the only place that is a true "other world" that we know of would be Sindhol.  If the Aes Sedai of the 2nd age could craft 2 ter'angeal to access this twisted place - it stands to reason a gateway could be created also. 

It's been shown that things thought impossible in one age can be discovered in another.  i.e.  bonding, curing taint madness, healing severing.  So who knows?  Maybe gateway discoveries are awaiting futurre channelers in the 4th age or beyond.
